title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 4 is in. Password values are omitted from the snapshot, including when `maskAllInputs` is false. Other input, textarea, and select values, and checkbox or radio checked state, come from the live property. With the default `maskAllInputs`, those values are stars of the same length. Text marked with `data-rewind-mask`, the `rewind-mask` class, or `maskTextSelector` keeps its length as stars. A blocked element is an empty box that keeps its width and height.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: part 5 (`takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
